itemdesc-sparker: Pocketable ignition device. “Only you can prevent peat fires.”
itemdesc-illuminant: Constantly provides a soft glow without heat. “Light must come from inside. You cannot ask the darkness to leave; you must turn on the light.”
blockdesc-flashbulb: Can be deployed for brilliant luminence. “Light must come from inside. You cannot ask the darkness to leave; you must turn on the light.”
itemdesc-wrench: Multitool prized by tinkerers. Wrench, SolderingIron, & CanOpener. “The best investment is in the tools of one's own trade.”
itemdesc-solderingiron: A curious design of soldering iron. Can be used to draw geometric designs on metal. “The best investment is in the tools of one's own trade.”
itemdesc-cogblade: Restored form of a previous age. “It's dangerous to go alone.”
itemdesc-clothes-face-goggles01: Mechanically adjustable telescopic goggles. “Steampunk? Cogpunk? Let's call it, 'Falxpunk'. ...For the time being, at least.”
itemdesc-flicker-*: Advanced ignition device. “Only you can prevent peat fires.”
blockdesc-*storagevessel*: Advanced technological storage container. Preservation through spatial compression. “It's bigger on the inside!?”
